ui.name: Boston
ui.lookup: Boston assessor (Boston only) · Town assessor · Registry of Deeds
ui.title_cos: Massachusetts closings are run by real estate attorneys, not title companies. Ask a Boston area investor friendly closing attorney, or search the Massachusetts Bar referral service
ui.title_call: a Massachusetts real estate closing attorney
ui.law: Massachusetts is an attorney state: a licensed attorney must run the closing. You can assign a purchase contract if the contract allows it; tell the seller in writing and sell only your contract, never the house. Most foreclosures are non-judicial (power of sale), with notices published in a local paper.
ui.groups: "Massachusetts Real Estate Investors Association (MassREIA)", "Black Diamond Real Estate Investors Group", "Boston Real Estate Investors Association"
ui.prefc: Estate or heirs: the town still lists a late owner's estate or heirs as owner, so the family has not sold yet. Condition comes from the Boston assessor's inspection. Complaints are reports to the city's 311 line in the last 30 days for housing problems, unsafe or abandoned buildings. Boston leads include 1 to 3 family houses; the towns in Middlesex County are single family only.
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, from the town sale data, most active first. Skip the big institutions and builders; the 2 to 20 purchase LLCs are the ones who buy wholesale deals. Look up the owner on the MA Corporations Division search and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers listed yet. The state sale dates are in a format the buyer list cannot read yet.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Boston area rough numbers per house: cosmetic 25-40k, kitchen+baths 50-80k, roof 15-30k, heating system 10-20k, lead paint deleading 10-30k, full gut 120-200k.
ui.sources: MassGIS statewide assessor parcel table (Middlesex County towns: owner, mailing address, value, year built, last sale), City of Boston FY26 assessing layer (owner occupied flag, building condition), Boston 311 cases from the last 30 days (housing, unsafe and abandoned building reports)
